The plate is a square dinner plate of about 26 cm across, spanning roughly 345 px, so about 13 px per cm. I can see two corn cob pieces standing on end, seen from above.

Each piece is about 100 px across, which is roughly 7.5 cm, so a cob cross-section of about 4.5 to 5 cm in diameter. The pieces look like short cuts of about 3 to 4 cm tall. I could not see the height directly, so that is an estimate.

Volume per piece: π × 2.4² × 3.5 ≈ 63 cm³. Corn on the cob, including the cob core, weighs about 0.9 g/cm³, so each piece is about 55 g. The two pieces together come to about 110 g.

Corn on the cob has about 90 kcal per 100 g, counting the cob as part of the weight.
